transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Severus. Please, have a seat. I've completed the preliminary scans on the Dark Mark. The results are... unusual.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: What do you mean, "unusual"? What exactly have you found?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: The Mark's magical signature is... changing. I can't tell whether it's reacting to something external or whether the curse itself is evolving. Your core magic appears stable, but this fluctuation is concerning.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Explain the implications. How does this affect my... our ability to function?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: At this stage, I cannot yet tell you whether this is dangerous. However, I need to run deeper diagnostic charms that will take several days and may be uncomfortable. The process will require monitoring the Mark's fluctuations in real-time.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Uncomfortable? Spare me the pleasantries, Healer. Just tell me what needs to be done and how long it will take. I have... pressing commitments.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: The diagnostic will require you to remain in a controlled magical environment for approximately seventy-two hours. The discomfort stems from the need to isolate and analyze the Mark's energy signature—it may feel like a persistent, low-grade magical drain. Your other commitments will have to wait.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Seventy-two hours...* Acceptable. Ensure the environment is secure. No one can know of this, not even... not him. I trust your discretion. Begin the diagnostic as soon as possible.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Your discretion is guaranteed, Severus. We'll begin tonight in the warded chambers. I'll need you to return by midnight. Bring nothing but your wand—the isolation field will reject any other magical objects.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Midnight, then. I'll be there. Make sure... the warded chambers are prepared. I won't tolerate any delays.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: They will be prepared. I'll be waiting. And Severus... try to get some rest before you come. The diagnostic will be taxing enough without exhaustion.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Rest... it's been some time since I indulged in such a luxury. Nonetheless, I'll do my best to comply. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have... matters to attend to before the appointed time.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Of course. Until midnight, then. Remember—nothing but your wand. I'll see you in the warded chambers.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I'll be there. Goodnight... Healer.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Goodnight, Severus. I'll have everything ready.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Indeed, it had better be. I expect efficiency, as usual. I'll be at the threshold precisely at midnight. Do not keep me waiting.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: You won't be kept waiting. The wards will recognize you. I'll be there.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Very well. I trust you've taken all necessary precautions to maintain confidentiality. The fewer who know of this, the better.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: The only other person aware is the Head of the Department, and even they don't know your identity. The records are coded. You have my word.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Coded... good. At least someone still knows how to maintain proper standards. I'll be there, on the dot. Now, I must depart before any... familiar faces catch sight of me. Good evening.

Openness.behavioral_evidence: He is willing to undergo an unusual diagnostic procedure, but his focus is on practical implications rather than curiosity about the magical anomaly itself.

Conscientiousness.behavioral_evidence: He demands efficiency, punctuality, and proper standards, stating, 'I'll be at the threshold precisely at midnight. Do not keep me waiting.'

Extraversion.behavioral_evidence: He is terse, avoids social pleasantries, and insists on confidentiality to avoid being seen by 'familiar faces.'

Agreeableness.behavioral_evidence: He dismisses the healer's concern for his rest with sarcasm ('Rest... it's been some time since I indulged in such a luxury') and issues blunt demands.

Neuroticism.behavioral_evidence: He shows persistent vigilance and concern for secrecy, repeatedly stressing that 'No one can know of this' and checking on precautions.
